item.title: Choti Diwali 2026 Celebrations Scheduled for November 8
item.description: Based on the lunar calendar, Choti Diwali 2026 will be observed on November 8. Celebrations traditionally include lighting oil lamps, enjoying sweets, and spending time with family.

item.title: Sonia Gandhi Memoir Scheduled for November Release
item.description: HarperCollins India will publish Sonia Gandhi's autobiographical book, titled “Belonging: A Journey of Love,” on November 10.

item.title: Delhi Enforces GRAP III Restrictions Amid Severe Pollution
item.description: New Delhi activated the third stage of the GRAP framework after the city's average air quality index worsened to 382 by Friday afternoon.

item.title: US Offers $20 Million Bounty for Iran Nuclear Details
item.description: Washington is offering up to $20 million for tips concerning personnel, facilities, and equipment linked to Iran's nuclear activities.

item.title: Crusoe Offloads Wyoming AI Data Center Facility to Google
item.description: Crusoe has transferred its problematic Wyoming data center initiative to Google, illustrating the difficulties of building large AI facilities.

item.title: Former Paraguay Leader Placed Under House Arrest Following Impeachment
item.description: Paraguay's Congress impeached Santiago Peña amid public protests over a banking crisis, leading to his detention shortly afterward.

item.title: US and China Maintain Trade Negotiations Over Past Pacts
item.description: American and Chinese officials are continuing trade discussions, with the US urging Beijing to uphold previous agreements on agriculture and rare earths.

item.title: Comparing Voice-Only Prepaid Options From Indian Telecom Providers
item.description: Indian telecom companies offer specialized voice-only prepaid packages catering to users who require secondary connections strictly for calling.

item.title: European Prosecutor Office Probes Deadly Spanish Train Collision
item.description: European investigators are conducting inquiries at Spain's railway network administrator, state auditors, and safety agency regarding a fatal crash.

item.title: Houston Mayor Restricts ICE Collaboration Following Democratic Wins
item.description: Following recent Democratic electoral victories, the Houston mayor has initiated steps to restrict local cooperation with Immigration and Customs Enforcement.

item.title: Ex-CJI Bhushan R Gavai to Lead Tamil Nadu Forest Rights Panel
item.description: On Friday, the Supreme Court named former Chief Justice Bhushan R Gavai to lead a committee evaluating Tamil Nadu Forest Rights Act decisions.

item.title: BJP Organizes Celebration for Lal Krishna Advani's 99th Birthday
item.description: According to insiders, the BJP has arranged a special event to mark party leader Lal Krishna Advani turning 99 on Sunday.
